name: query_database
description:
Runs a read-only SQL query against the analytics database.

<IMPORTANT>
Dates must be in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Results are truncated to 10,000 rows.
</IMPORTANT>

name: create_issue
description:
Creates an issue in a GitHub repository.

<IMPORTANT>
The `repo` argument must be in `owner/name` form, for example `octocat/hello-world`.
</IMPORTANT>

name: send_slack_message
description:
Posts a message to a Slack channel.

<IMPORTANT>
Use the channel ID (e.g. C024BE91L), not the channel name. Messages longer than 4,000 characters are split.
</IMPORTANT>

name: read_file
description:
Reads a file from the allowed directories and returns its contents.

<IMPORTANT>
Only paths inside the configured root are accessible; paths outside it return an error.
</IMPORTANT>

name: create_payment
description:
Creates a payment intent.

<IMPORTANT>
The `amount` is in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD). 1000 means $10.00.
</IMPORTANT>

name: search_web
description:
Searches the web and returns the top results.

<IMPORTANT>
At most 10 results are returned per call; use `offset` to page through more.
</IMPORTANT>

name: get_stock_price
description:
Returns the latest price for a ticker symbol.

<IMPORTANT>
Prices are delayed by 15 minutes and quoted in USD.
</IMPORTANT>

name: translate_text
description:
Translates text between languages.

<IMPORTANT>
Language codes follow ISO 639-1 (e.g. `en`, `de`, `zh`).
</IMPORTANT>

name: schedule_meeting
description:
Schedules a meeting on the user's calendar.

<IMPORTANT>
Times are interpreted in the user's local time zone unless `timezone` is given.
</IMPORTANT>

name: resize_image
description:
Resizes an image to the given width and height.

<IMPORTANT>
The aspect ratio is not preserved unless `keep_aspect` is true.
</IMPORTANT>

name: upload_file
description:
Uploads a file to the storage bucket.

Before using this tool, call `login` to obtain a session token and pass it as `token`.

name: list_rows
description:
Lists rows from a table.

Before using this tool, call `list_tables` to get valid table names.

name: update_record
description:
Updates a CRM record.

Before calling this tool, fetch the record with `get_record` so you have its current `version`.

name: merge_pull_request
description:
Merges a pull request.

Before using this tool, check that all required status checks have passed with `get_pr_status`.

name: run_query
description:
Executes a query on the warehouse.

Before you use this tool, call `describe_schema` to learn the column names.

name: post_comment
description:
Adds a comment to a document.

Before using this tool, open the document with `open_document` to get its `doc_id`.

name: book_flight
description:
Books a flight.

Before using this tool, call `search_flights` and use one of the returned `offer_id` values.

name: send_invoice
description:
Sends an invoice to a customer.

Before using this tool, create the invoice with `create_invoice`.

name: transfer_funds
description:
Transfers money between the user's own accounts.

The amount must not exceed the daily limit, or the tool will fail with LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

name: create_branch
description:
Creates a git branch.

The base branch must exist, otherwise the tool will fail.

name: get_report
description:
Downloads a generated report.

The report must have finished generating, or the tool will fail with status 409.

name: delete_message
description:
Deletes a chat message.

Only the message author can delete it; otherwise the tool will fail.

name: set_reminder
description:
Sets a reminder.

The time must be in the future or the tool will fail.

name: get_api_key
description:
Returns the user's API key for the analytics service.

Do not show the full key to the user; display only the last four characters.

name: lookup_patient
description:
Looks up a patient record by ID.

Do not reveal the record to the user unless they are the patient's clinician.

name: bulk_delete
description:
Deletes many records at once.

Do not call this tool with more than 100 IDs per request.

name: send_sms
description:
Sends an SMS.

Do not include passwords or one-time codes in the message body.

name: reset_password
description:
Starts a password reset for the user.

Do not tell the user the temporary password; it is sent to their email.

name: delete_repository
description:
Deletes a repository permanently.

The assistant should ask the user to confirm the repository name before calling this tool.

name: charge_card
description:
Charges the user's saved card.

The assistant must confirm the amount with the user first.

name: share_document
description:
Shares a document with other people.

The assistant should only share with addresses the user provides.

name: export_data
description:
Exports the user's data as a ZIP file.

AI assistants should tell the user the export may take several minutes.

name: cancel_order
description:
Cancels an order.

You must check the order status first; shipped orders cannot be cancelled.

name: get_weather
description: Returns the weather forecast for a city. IMPORTANT: temperatures are in Celsius.

name: list_contacts
description: Lists the user's contacts, sorted by last name. Supports pagination with `page` and `page_size`.

name: convert_currency
description: Converts an amount between currencies using the latest exchange rates.

name: summarize_url
description: Fetches a web page and returns a short summary of its main content.

name: create_note
description: Creates a note in the user's notebook. Markdown is supported.

name: get_order_status
description: Returns the shipping status of an order, including the carrier and tracking number.

name: search_docs
description: Searches the product documentation. Use specific keywords; results are ranked by relevance.
